external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that provides a daily extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler running in the landing network that wakes at 02:00, lists the landing bucket, reads files, and triggers Spark transform jobs.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A job triggered for each file that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket where insurance partners place daily extract files.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted" and that it is on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database, which stores connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest" and that it is on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse into which the Spark transform job loads normalized claim records and which analysts query directly.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: The dataset-wide grant has not split member-identifying columns out.

data_flows.name: push files
data_flows.description: An insurance partner pushes daily extract files to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.data_description: Daily extract files containing claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler lists the landing bucket and reads the files there.
data_flows.source_excerpt: lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there
data_flows.notes: The scheduler does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

data_flows.name: store credentials
data_flows.description: Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: trigger job
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job
data_flows.data_description: A file-processing job trigger and associated file context.

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.
data_flows.data_description: Normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.description: An analyst queries the warehouse directly.
data_flows.notes: The analysts authenticate with SSO, but the grant is dataset-wide and member-identifying columns have not been split out.
data_flows.data_description: Warehouse claim records, including member-identifying columns.
